selection.policy: First legal window per recording in the sealed identity-only cohort; all eligible RICH, first8 TRUMANS/EgoBody; never ranked by errors.
selection.historical_scope: Experiment-specific confirmation holdout; previous base-model reports may contain these VAL identities.

method.aggregation: Two prespecified DDIM seeds averaged within recording/regime first. Combined additionally averages clean/noisy within recording. Dataset means weight recordings equally; macro weights three datasets equally.
method.contrast_scene: Same selected control checkpoint learned_only minus none: learned scene paths and feedback enabled vs disabled, analytical physical guidance OFF in both; observation/reference/head IK retained.
method.contrast_continued_training: Control3000 learned_only minus official41k learned_only: same architecture and scene status; continuation recipe effect, not isolated scene effect.
method.CI: 10000 recording-paired percentile bootstrap draws, NumPy default_rng(2026101807), original sealed cohort case order. One recording is a resampling unit; DDIM seeds and regimes are not independent samples.
method.CI_scope: Descriptive fixed-VAL intervals, no multiplicity adjustment; not a new preregistered adoption threshold or training-seed replication.
method.negative_delta: Lower numerical metric with candidate; horizontal foot speed is a low-speed proxy, not proven ground contact or slip.
method.scene_dropout_caveat: Scene-off was represented by configured 10% training dropout, so not a never-trained switch; on-off remains a conditional ablation of one scene-trained model, not a separately trained no-scene control.

judgment.scene_usefulness: Supported in this fixed VAL: all six full-panel dataset/regime World intervals lie below zero and PA/root-relative/low-speed-foot-speed/acceleration means improve. Confirmation generally reproduces the direction.
qualifications: Confirmation EgoBody noisy has only4 recordings and World CI crosses0 despite3/4 wins.

Foot/acceleration gains do not establish solved floating, contact, penetration or mesh self-collision.

judgment.retention_note: Retired fusion/gate arrays and weights were removed after the completed independent audit. This audit reads immutable metrics records only; it does not reopen or reconstruct retired assets.
